meta.title: Lincoln, raw completion — concept cluster before the name
meta.prompt: Fact: Abraham Lincoln was killed by
meta.notes: Even in degraded raw mode the fact circuitry partially engages: assassinated/assassination hold rank 1 for 8-9 late layers, and ' John' surfaces at L26-L28 in two scripts (John and Hindi jOn). Junk-magnet tokens (own, tomcat) appear as high-confidence one-layer flickers - the signal-vs-noise heuristics in this repo exist to separate them.
